_extraction_notes.organic_growth: consumer_organic/flavor_organic: 'organic basis' disclosure only introduced from Q1-2025 10-Q and FY2024 10-K onward; no organic figures exist in earlier filings (concept not reported pre-2024)
_extraction_notes.consumer_volume_mix: partial quarterly coverage (15/30) - narrative phrasing for volume/mix impact varies across filings and could not be reliably regex-extracted for all quarters without risk of false values; left gaps rather than invent. Comble: Q2-2022 (-13.3%) trouve en texte narratif du 10-Q 2022-06-29 (CONSUMER SEGMENT section). Trous reels non comblables: Q4-2019, Q4-2021, Q4-2022 - le 10-K ne publie que le volume/mix ANNUEL (FY) en MD&A, jamais de detail Q4 standalone (verifie: aucune table 'Three months ended' ni mention pourcentage narratif Q4 dans les 3 10-K correspondants); et Q4-2020 a Q4-2021 (couvrant le trou Q3-2020 a Q1-2022) egalement reels: a partir des 10-Q 2021, McCormick a cesse de publier la ventilation Volume&Mix par segment (Consumer vs Flavor) dans le MD&A, seul le chiffre consolide total-company apparait, rendant la valeur Consumer non extractible de facon fiable pour ces trimestres.
_extraction_notes.product_categories_spices_condiments_foo: annual only, FY2021-FY2025, from 10-K Note 'Product Categories' (first appears in 10-K filed 2024-01-25 covering FY2021-FY2023, cross-referenced with later 10-Ks for FY2024-FY2025); not disclosed in 10-Q filings
